_context: CRISPR MTAP-knockout derivative of Res259 made by the Caldovic lab (Children's National) for CTF DDI project syn64500888 'Targeting PRMT5 in MTAP-deleted NF1 High Grade Gliomas'. RNA-seq syn76980257, proteomics syn64500894/syn64500895. Manuscript expected mid-2027. Source: data lead reply on NFOSI-2053 (2026-11-10).

basicInfo.description: Res259 pediatric astrocytoma line with CRISPR knockout of MTAP, used to model PRMT5-inhibitor (TNG908) sensitivity in MTAP-deleted gliomas.

otherInformation: Derived from Res259 (RRID:CVCL_DG10) by CRISPR MTAP knockout. Used to test PRMT5 inhibitor TNG908 alone and with MEK inhibitors.
